sentences.en: Methods:The microsurgical anatomy of the superior hypophyseal artery was performed in 48 internal carotid arteries on 24 cranial specimens.

sentences.en: Objective To evaluate the sex hormone and hypophyseal hormone alterations in male liver cirrhosis patients and their clinical significance.

sentences.en: For this reason, we improved the previous culturing method and established the joint culturing system of hypothalamic neuron and hypophyseal cell by using joint culturing technique.

sentences.en: In this study, the ophthalmic, clinoid segment of contralateral ICA and the contralateral superior hypophyseal artery were successfully exposed in 100% of specimens (15 specimens, 30 sides).
sentences.vi: Trong nghiên cứu này, đoạn đáy mắt, clinoid của ICA bên cạnh và động mạch hạ nhịp tim bên trên được phơi nhiễm thành công trong 100% mẫu vật (15 mẫu, 30 mặt).
